# Lucide Camera

- Asset: `camera.svg`
- Upstream icon: <https://lucide.dev/icons/camera>
- Upstream package version: `@lucide/vue` 1.31.0
- License: ISC; retained verbatim in `LICENSE`

`camera-24.png` is a pre-rasterized derivative used by the native X11 selector.
The SVG is not parsed and no network request is performed during capture.
